name: hep_static_w5b_1016
structural_change: v15 successor of the retired flat hfd_lk_ep (13 failed routes): one ~8k-flop master for all 9 ep windows, lane gearbox 613b->512b fixed 4-in-5 format + off-die elastic RX pingpong (0az boundary), every port pin-registered, one clock root. Route-2 fix of route-1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (setup/hold conflict at enable-mux D pins with one 612-load select): selects replicated per 64-b slice, bypass-free SRAM leaf, macro columns facing one centre datapath channel, logic band at the COLL/SerDes faces. Route-3 fix of route-2 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (12 zero-capacity M2/M4 gcells on 3 nets at the inward SRAM faces of the 47 um centre channel; abutted N-S macro pairs left no horizontal corridor): the two macro rows are separated by a 21.6 um horizontal channel (outline 434.72 x 315.36 inside the 434.72 x 515.2 window), giving the face escapes and the band->channel nets a crossing corridor. Route-4 native fix (route 3 CLOSED TT +128.49 / FF +7.69 but native launch 223.2 ps on 3 sd_tx pins, capture 212.7 ps on sd_rx[1]): sd_rx[1] (SerDes IDLE bit) loads ONE pin flop (it fed 9), the per-slice data copies and the RX gearbox beat move one edge later (+1 RX cycle at the off-die boundary, +520 flops); clk entry moved west on the S face to x 151.2-153.36 um (between tx_frame and the controls) to cut the late W-face boundary arrival. Route-5 fix of route-4 native FAIL (launch 259.7 on 25 sd_tx pins at W y 2-8, capture 221.3 on tx_frame S x 16-19; R 429.6 spread 100.8): SW corner pin-flop crowding where the W SerDes and S COLL pin-flop fields meet -> 19.44 um corner keep-out on both faces, sd_tx 512 pins over 77.8 um (6.6/um, was 7.5), S pins shifted +19.44 um (rx_pin unchanged); same RTL, same outline. Route-5b (parallel to route 5 bc6c91699): route-5 gate showed the sd_rx pin flops squeezed into the 17 um W channel beside the lower-left macro (red strip); both macro rows move N by 56.16 um (outline 434.72 x 371.52, inside the 434.72 x 515.2 window) so the whole W SerDes pin field (y 21.6-172.8) faces the logic band, not a macro.

job.purpose: HBM v15 link endpoint master (ep_N0..N3/ep_S0..S4): static lane gearbox + 0az off-die elastic RX boundary; replaces hfd_lk_ep v14

slot_change_request.reason: route 1 (b58969306) EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at FF -79 ps on u_block.pin_flit[484]/D: setup/hold conflict at a 2:1 enable-mux D pin (select vp[2] = one flop fanning out to 612 flops, SS setup +62 ps; data leg dout->pin_flit needs >= +109 ps FF). Route 2: (RTL) every wide select replicated per 64-b slice (block pin_flit, pingpong merge, TX beat idle), SRAM leaf without the never-firing write->read bypass; (floorplan) two abutted N-S macro columns in the upper part, left column MY / right R0 so all rd_out / wd_in[265:0] / clk faces face one 47.3 um centre channel (M3+M5 2,300 vertical tracks for 1,224 crossing bits = 0.53) (bits 0..305 left half, 306..611 right half), outer 20.3 um edge channels for wd_in[305:266] + ties, lower 114 um band for the gearboxes and pin registers (SerDes W pins 2..140 um, COLL S face, clk S centre). Outline 434.72 x 293.76 inside the 434.72 x 515.2 ep window.

pin_regs.reason: hfd_ep_static registers every input and every output at its pin in RTL (hfd_ep_static.sv: p_* input pin registers for tx_v/tx_frame/rx_* controls/sd_rx/sd_st; sd_tx = the TX beat register; rx_pin_v/rx_pin_flit = the pingpong merge registers; rx_block_ready/phy_up/fault/fault_cause output registers); a recipe-3 wrapper would add a second +1-cycle stage on 2,450 pins
